panels.title: Received by zone
panels.description: Bytes the selected tenants' VMs received over the time range, by where the sender sits. Source: lachesis (eBPF on compute nodes).

targets.expr: (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (zone) ((clamp_min(lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx",zone!~"infra|miss|multicast"} - lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx",zone!~"infra|miss|multicast"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx",zone!~"infra|miss|multicast"})), "zone", "External", "zone", "external"), "zone", "Same tenant", "zone", "same_tenant"), "zone", "Other tenant", "zone", "other_tenant"), "zone", "Shared network", "zone", "shared") or label_replace(sum by () ((clamp_min(lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx",zone=~"infra|miss|multicast"} - lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx",zone=~"infra|miss|multicast"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx",zone=~"infra|miss|multicast"})), "zone", "Other", "", ""))

panels.title: Sent by zone
panels.description: Bytes the selected tenants' VMs sent over the time range, by where the receiver sits. Source: lachesis (eBPF on compute nodes).

targets.expr: (label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (zone) ((clamp_min(lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx",zone!~"infra|miss|multicast"} - lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx",zone!~"infra|miss|multicast"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx",zone!~"infra|miss|multicast"})), "zone", "External", "zone", "external"), "zone", "Same tenant", "zone", "same_tenant"), "zone", "Other tenant", "zone", "other_tenant"), "zone", "Shared network", "zone", "shared") or label_replace(sum by () ((clamp_min(lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx",zone=~"infra|miss|multicast"} - lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx",zone=~"infra|miss|multicast"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx",zone=~"infra|miss|multicast"})), "zone", "Other", "", ""))

panels.title: Top tenants
panels.description: The 10 selected tenants that moved the most bytes over the time range. Sent and received are counted separately: a transfer between two VMs is counted once at each end. Source: lachesis (eBPF on compute nodes).

targets.expr: ((sum by (tenant_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx"} - lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx"})) and on(tenant_id) topk(10, sum by (tenant_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} - lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"})))) * on(tenant_id) group_left(name) max by (tenant_id, name) (lachesis_tenant_info)) or label_replace((sum by (tenant_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx"} - lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx"})) and on(tenant_id) topk(10, sum by (tenant_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} - lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"})))) unless on(tenant_id) lachesis_tenant_info, "name", "$1", "tenant_id", "(.*)")

((sum by (tenant_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx"} - lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx"})) and on(tenant_id) topk(10, sum by (tenant_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} - lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"})))) * on(tenant_id) group_left(name) max by (tenant_id, name) (lachesis_tenant_info)) or label_replace((sum by (tenant_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx"} - lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx"})) and on(tenant_id) topk(10, sum by (tenant_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} - lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"})))) unless on(tenant_id) lachesis_tenant_info, "name", "$1", "tenant_id", "(.*)")

panels.title: Top VMs
panels.description: The 10 VMs of the selected tenants that moved the most bytes over the time range. Source: lachesis (eBPF on compute nodes).

targets.expr: ((sum by (server_id, tenant_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx"} - lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx"})) and on(server_id) topk(10, sum by (server_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} - lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"})))) * on(server_id) group_left(name) max by (server_id, name) (lachesis_server_info)) or label_replace((sum by (server_id, tenant_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx"} - lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="tx"})) and on(server_id) topk(10, sum by (server_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} - lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"})))) unless on(server_id) lachesis_server_info, "name", "$1", "server_id", "(.*)")

((sum by (server_id, tenant_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx"} - lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx"})) and on(server_id) topk(10, sum by (server_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} - lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"})))) * on(server_id) group_left(name) max by (server_id, name) (lachesis_server_info)) or label_replace((sum by (server_id, tenant_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx"} - lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",direction="rx"})) and on(server_id) topk(10, sum by (server_id) ((clamp_min(lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} - lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"} offset $__range, 0) or lachesis_server_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant"})))) unless on(server_id) lachesis_server_info, "name", "$1", "server_id", "(.*)")

panels.title: Traffic over time
panels.description: Bits per second of the selected tenants, by direction and zone. Source: lachesis (eBPF on compute nodes).

targets.expr: 8 * label_replace(label_replace((label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(sum by (zone, direction) (rate(lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",zone!~"infra|miss|multicast"}[$__rate_interval])), "zone", "External", "zone", "external"), "zone", "Same tenant", "zone", "same_tenant"), "zone", "Other tenant", "zone", "other_tenant"), "zone", "Shared network", "zone", "shared") or label_replace(sum by (direction) (rate(lachesis_tenant_bytes_total{tenant_id=~"$tenant",zone=~"infra|miss|multicast"}[$__rate_interval])), "zone", "Other", "", "")), "direction", "Sent", "direction", "tx"), "direction", "Received", "direction", "rx")
